chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Mudarib, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Muhammad, take this slave girl; she will serve you and you may derive benefit from her. So when you go out, return her to us.'

key_terms.وَتُصِيبُ مِنْهَا: And you may derive benefit/profit from her

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about taking a slave girl for service and benefit?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the concept of *Istimta'* (usufruct) applied to slaves, where the Imam grants Muhammad ibn Mudarib the right to use a slave girl for service and benefit while retaining ownership within the Ahl al-Bayt's household. It serves as a foundational precedent for the flexibility of temporary rights in pre-modern Islamic social structures, distinguishing between ownership and the temporary grant of utility. The instruction to return her upon departure underscores the temporary nature of this specific arrangement rather than a permanent transfer of property.
